areas.name: The hidden signal
areas.hint: Find the QR marker beneath the lamp. Scan it to wake the four lights.
areas.description: The lights reveal a secret. Read their colors from left to right.

areas.name: The colorful code
areas.hint: Enter the four light colors, from left to right.
areas.description: Listen to Alexa, then say: Alexa, the answer is five!

onComplete.message: I am the number of fingers on one hand. What number am I? Say: Alexa, the answer is five.

areas.name: You solved the riddle!
areas.hint: Tell Alexa your answer to the riddle.
areas.description: Success! The lights and the voice have accepted your answers. You completed the game.

controls.name: Four lights: red, blue, green, yellow
